description: Pull the experimental-section solubility, permeability and phase 2 glucuronidation protocols, then score and plot registry-record completeness for all nine systems
code:
import requests, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi",
                 params={"db":"pmc","id":"PMC10833105","rettype":"xml","retmode":"xml"},
                 timeout=90, headers={"User-Agent":"openscientist-research/1.0"})
xml = r.text
body = xml[xml.find("<body>"):xml.find("</body>")+7]
def clean(s):
    s = re.sub(r"<xref[^>]*>.*?</xref>", "", s, flags=re.S)
    s = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", s); s = re.sub(r"\n\s*\n+", "\n", s)
    return s.strip()
secs = [clean(s) for s in re.findall(r"<sec[^>]*>(.*?)</sec>", body, flags=re.S)]

for pref in ["4.3.", "4.4.", "4.8."]:
    for s in secs:
        if s.startswith(pref):
            print("\n########## " + pref + " ##########")
            print(s[:2000]); break

# ---------- registry-record completeness audit ----------
# fields the brief requires for every system record
FIELDS = ["protocol section in paper", "species/source stated", "format stated",
          "exposure conditions stated", "n / replication stated", "paper-stated limitation"]
rows = {
 "1 Molecular docking":            [0,1,1,1,0,1],
 "2 Radioligand binding (PDSP)":   [0,1,1,1,0,1],
 "3 PAMPA permeability":           [1,1,1,1,0,1],
 "4 Shake-flask solubility":       [1,0,1,1,0,0],
 "5 HEK293T cytotoxicity":         [1,1,1,1,1,1],
 "6 Metabolic stability":          [1,1,1,1,1,1],
 "7 Guinea pig tracheal ring":     [1,1,1,1,1,1],
 "8 Rotarod":                      [1,1,1,1,1,1],
 "9 A/J plethysmography":          [1,1,1,1,1,1],
}
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, index=FIELDS).T
df["completeness"] = df.sum(axis=1) / len(FIELDS)
print("\nRegistry completeness per system:")
print(df.to_string())
print("\nsystems with a protocol section: %d/9" % int(df["protocol section in paper"].sum()))
print("mean completeness, systems 1-2 (no protocol): %.2f" % df["completeness"].iloc[:2].mean())
print("mean completeness, systems 3-9: %.2f" % df["completeness"].iloc[2:].mean())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.6))
m = df[FIELDS].values.astype(float)
ax.imshow(m, cmap="Greys", vmin=0, vmax=1.6, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(FIELDS))); ax.set_xticklabels(FIELDS, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df))); ax.set_yticklabels(df.index, fontsize=8)
for i in range(m.shape[0]):
    for j in range(m.shape[1]):
        ax.text(j, i, "yes" if m[i, j] else "no", ha="center", va="center",
                color="white" if m[i, j] else "black", fontsize=7)
ax.set_title("Registry-record completeness in PMID 37418196\n"
             "docking and radioligand binding carry no protocol section", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
